selection.core_rule: each supported PE: B1, B4, B16 and largest commonly explored batch; complete 3 paired trials before extras
selection.representative_rule: At most two completed core pairs (each >=3 current-protocol trials): baseline B1 and highest median Compile throughput across complete core pairs; ties lower PE/batch. No fastest-trial selection.
selection.stability_rule: Largest common batch whose predicted per-mode stability worker fits the cap; PE with highest explored Compile throughput; both modes run
